name: deeptutor-desktop-shell
author: DeepTutor Desktop Shell
description: Minimal Electron shell wrapping the DeepTutor web frontend. No Python backend bundled; the web's own Next standalone server runs inside the shell.

scripts.dist: npm run bundle:node && npm run build:web && electron-builder
scripts.dist:mac: npm run bundle:node && npm run build:web && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:win: npm run bundle:node:win && npm run build:web && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:linux: npm run bundle:node && npm run build:web && electron-builder --linux
